project(qapt VERSION 3.0.5)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/modules")
include(ECMSetupVersion)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets DBus Core5Compat)
find_package(Xapian REQUIRED)
find_package(AptPkg REQUIRED)
find_package(PolkitQt6-1 REQUIRED)
kde_enable_exceptions()
ecm_setup_version(${PROJECT_VERSION} VARIABLE_PREFIX QAPT VERSION_HEADER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qaptversion.h" SOVERSION 6)
set(QAPT_WORKER_VERSION 6)
set(QAPT_WORKER_RDN org.kubuntu.qaptworker)
set(QAPT_WORKER_VERSION_STRING "\"6\"")
set(QAPT_WORKER_RDN_VERSIONED_STRING "\"org.kubuntu.qaptworker6\"")
set(QAPT_WORKER_RDN_VERSIONED ${QAPT_WORKER_RDN}${QAPT_WORKER_VERSION})
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} ${POLKITQT-1_INCLUDE_DIR} ${XAPIAN_INCLUDE_DIR} ${APTPKG_INCLUDE_DIR})
add_subdirectory(src)
target_link_libraries(QApt PRIVATE Qt6::Core5Compat)
